findings.message: Object.hasOwn is ES2022 (Node 16.9+). If this package targets older runtimes, this will throw TypeError. Additionally, if `cache` can be null/undefined, Object.hasOwn throws whereas Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call also throws on null/undefined — behavior unchanged there. Consider Object.hasOwn only if runtime baseline guarantees ES2022; otherwise keep hasOwnProperty.call. Behavioral semantics for own keys (incl. false/0/''/null) remain correct, so no functional regression for valid runtimes.

snippets.code: exports.get = (cache, key, fallback) => Object.hasOwn(cache, key) ? cache[key] : fallback;
